title: A Codex root session's Engram tools vanished across a host restart and returned only after the next one
outcome: We know why a running Codex root session can lose its Engram tools around a TermAl host restart, and either it no longer happens or the session is told plainly.
acceptance: The cause is identified from evidence, or the item records that a later restart did not reproduce it and says what was checked.
If a defect is confirmed, a fix or a plain notice to the session is reviewed and gated; if none is found, the item closes stating that.
